QuestInfo.name: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Cootie's Suggestion
QuestInfo.0: Things are still sticky, but Cootie the Really Small is free for now. Talk to #b#p1500000##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
QuestInfo.1: Cootie the Really Small suggested working together improve fairy-human relations. Talk to #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1500001##k granted you permission to search the school.

0.0: I knew she'd see the fairy-love deep in my soul. This isn't a full pardon yet, but it's progress. You might be a pretty good human. I would like to know your name\r\n
0.1: #b#h0##k? It's almost... fairyish. Do you have any fairy in you?
0.2: I find it strange that all the little fairy children disappeared. It reeks of human treachery, but this might be a chance to show them that our cultures aren't so different after all. If we find them, we could bridge the gap between humans and fairies for all time! I hereby dub us the #e#bEllinel Academy Problem Solvers#k!

yes.0: Good idea, right? Tell them we'll be their heroes.\r\n(Talk to #b#p1500001##k.)

no.0: You don't want to be a part of a super secret detective team?

npc.0: Tell them we'll be their heroes.\r\n(Talk to #b#p1500001##k.)
